title: Nonce Replay Defense
intent: Consume signed decision nonces once to prevent approval replay.
problem: Without atomic nonce consumption follows successful signature and binding checks, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the nonce replay defense contract.
context: This pattern addresses signed decisions represent one-time authority; its concrete control is atomic nonce consumption follows successful signature and binding checks.
forces: Correctness requires that invalid signatures never consume nonce state
Operational pressure can cause: process-local nonce state resets unexpectedly
solution: Implement atomic nonce consumption follows successful signature and binding checks. Verify the anchored symbol `AnalogReviewError` with `test_checked_in_candidates_produce_deterministic_immutable_packets` before reuse.
invariants: invalid signatures never consume nonce state
a valid nonce succeeds no more than once
failure_modes: two verifiers lack a shared consumption store
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `process-local nonce state resets unexpectedly` and fails closed if the nonce replay defense evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For nonce replay defense, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to atomic nonce consumption follows successful signature and binding checks.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: signed decisions represent one-time authority
Do not apply when: the signed message is informational and reusable
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
not_when: the signed message is informational and reusable
